title: Disable advertising ID
detail: Apps can no longer use your advertising ID to show personalized ads.

title: Disable tailored experiences
detail: Microsoft stops using diagnostic data to personalize tips, ads and recommendations.

title: Don't share language list with websites
detail: Websites can no longer read your installed languages to tailor content.

title: Stop feedback prompts
detail: Windows no longer pops up requests to rate or give feedback.

title: Disable app launch tracking
detail: Windows stops tracking which apps you open to rank Start and search results.

title: Disable activity history
detail: Windows stops collecting and uploading the apps, files and sites you use.

title: Limit diagnostic data to required only
detail: Sends only the minimum diagnostic data Windows needs to stay secure and updated.

title: Disable Bing web results in Start search
detail: Start search shows only local apps, files and settings.

title: Hide Start menu recommendations
detail: Removes promoted tips, shortcuts and new-app suggestions from Start.

title: Disable Widgets and the news feed
detail: Removes the Widgets board and its taskbar button.

title: Hide Copilot taskbar button
detail: Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar. Copilot stays installed.

title: Hide Task View taskbar button
detail: Removes the Task View button. Win+Tab still works.

title: Disable lock screen tips and fun facts
detail: Removes ads, tips and trivia from the lock screen.

title: Disable suggestions in Settings
detail: Removes suggested content and promotions from the Settings app.

title: Disable tips and suggestions notifications
detail: Stops "tips, tricks and suggestions" notifications.

title: Disable welcome experience after updates
detail: Skips the "what's new" screens shown after updates and sign-in.

title: Disable "Get even more out of Windows" nag
detail: Stops the full-screen setup reminder that pushes Microsoft services.

title: Stop automatic installs of suggested apps
detail: Windows stops silently installing promoted apps and games. Already installed apps stay.

title: Show file extensions
detail: Shows extensions like .exe and .pdf, which makes disguised files easier to spot.

title: Use the classic right-click menu
detail: Shows the full context menu right away instead of "Show more options".

title: Disable OneDrive ads in File Explorer
detail: Stops sync provider notifications and promotions inside Explorer.

title: Hide Office.com files in Explorer Home
detail: Explorer Home shows only local files, not cloud files from Office.com.

title: Don't auto-restart while signed in
detail: Windows waits for you to restart instead of rebooting on its own to finish updates.

title: Disable peer-to-peer update sharing
detail: Updates download only from Microsoft. Your PC doesn't upload updates to other PCs.

title: Exclude drivers from Windows Update
detail: Windows Update stops replacing your drivers. Update GPU and other drivers yourself.

title: Notify before downloading updates
detail: Windows asks before downloading updates. Some editions, including Home, may ignore this.

title: Disable app access to account info
detail: Apps can no longer read your name, picture and other account info.

title: Disable app access to diagnostic info
detail: Apps can no longer read diagnostic data about your other apps.

title: Disable app access to generative AI
detail: Apps can no longer use Windows' built-in generative AI features.

title: Disable app access to presence sensing
detail: Apps can no longer tell whether you are at the device.

title: Disable app access to location
detail: Apps can no longer read your location.

title: Disable app access to the camera
detail: Apps can no longer use your webcam.

title: Disable app access to the microphone
detail: Apps can no longer record audio.

title: Disable app access to notifications
detail: Apps can no longer read your notifications.

title: Disable app access to motion data
detail: Apps can no longer read the activity and movement sensor.

title: Disable app access to contacts
detail: Apps can no longer read your contacts.

title: Disable app access to the calendar
detail: Apps can no longer read or add appointments.

title: Disable app access to phone calls
detail: Apps can no longer make or manage phone calls.

title: Disable app access to call history
detail: Apps can no longer read your call history.

title: Disable app access to email
detail: Apps can no longer read or send email.

title: Disable app access to tasks
detail: Apps can no longer read or edit your task lists.

title: Disable app access to messages
detail: Apps can no longer read or send text messages.

title: Disable app control of radios
detail: Apps can no longer switch Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other radios on or off.

title: Disable app sync with unpaired devices
detail: Apps can no longer share and sync info with wireless devices that are not explicitly paired.

title: Disable app access to Documents
detail: Apps can no longer open your Documents folder on their own.

title: Disable app access to Pictures
detail: Apps can no longer open your Pictures folder on their own.

title: Disable app access to Videos
detail: Apps can no longer open your Videos folder on their own.

title: Disable app access to Music
detail: Apps can no longer open your Music folder on their own.

title: Disable app access to the file system
detail: Apps can no longer browse your whole file system on their own.

title: Disable app access to passkeys
detail: Apps can no longer create or use passkeys.

title: Disable app access to Bluetooth
detail: Apps can no longer use Bluetooth.

title: Disable app access to eye tracking
detail: Apps can no longer read where you look.

title: Disable app screenshots
detail: Apps can no longer capture screenshots on their own.

title: Disable borderless app screenshots
detail: Apps can no longer capture screenshots without a border.

title: Disable app access to human interface devices
detail: Apps can no longer use custom devices such as controllers and sensors.

title: Disable background apps
detail: Apps no longer run in the background.

title: Disable voice activation by apps
detail: Apps can no longer wake up and listen for voice commands.

title: Disable voice activation while locked
detail: Apps can no longer use voice activation from the lock screen.

title: Disable transmission of typing information
detail: Windows stops sending information about how you type to Microsoft.

title: Disable input personalization
detail: Windows stops collecting your typing and inking to personalize dictionaries and recognition.

title: Disable online speech recognition
detail: Voice dictation stops sending your speech to Microsoft's online recognition service.

title: Disable clipboard history storage
detail: Windows no longer keeps a history of what you copy.

title: Disable app notifications
detail: Apps no longer show toast notifications.

title: Disable Cortana
detail: Cortana is turned off by policy.

title: Disable Find My Device
detail: Windows stops reporting this device's location for the Find My Device service.

title: Turn off location services device-wide
detail: The whole device location platform is off, for all apps and users. Stronger than the per-app location toggle.

title: Disable suggestions in Timeline
detail: Timeline (Task View history) no longer shows suggested content.

title: Disable suggestions in Start
detail: Start no longer occasionally shows suggestions for apps and content.

title: Disable account notifications in Settings
detail: The Settings app stops showing Microsoft account notifications and prompts.

title: Disable Windows Spotlight
detail: The lock screen stops downloading Spotlight wallpapers, facts and promotions from the internet.

title: Disable notifications on the lock screen
detail: App notifications no longer appear on the lock screen.

title: Disable Windows Copilot
detail: Copilot in Windows is turned off by policy, not just hidden from the taskbar.

title: Disable Recall snapshots
detail: Copilot+ PCs stop saving snapshots of your screen for Recall.

title: Disable Microsoft account cloud content in search
detail: Search no longer pulls results from your personal Microsoft account's cloud services.

title: Disable work or school cloud content in search
detail: Search no longer pulls results from your work or school account's cloud services.

title: Disable device search history
detail: Windows stops storing and showing your previous searches.

title: Disable search highlights
detail: The search box stops showing daily highlights, pictures and suggested content.

title: Hide the search box on the taskbar
detail: Removes the search box from the taskbar. Search still works from Start.

title: Hide the Chat taskbar icon
detail: Removes the Microsoft Teams Chat icon from the taskbar.

title: Hide the "Meet now" taskbar icon
detail: Removes the Meet Now video-call icon from the taskbar corner.

title: Hide the mobile device panel in Start
detail: Start no longer shows the Phone Link mobile-device companion panel next to the menu.

title: Disable recent items in Jump Lists
detail: Taskbar Jump Lists no longer show your recent and frequent documents.

title: Hide the Spotlight desktop icon
detail: Removes the Windows Spotlight "learn about this picture" icon from the desktop.

title: Enable "End task" in the taskbar menu
detail: Lets you end a stuck app straight from its taskbar button's right-click menu.

title: Switch to the last active window on taskbar click
detail: Clicking a taskbar button jumps to the app's last used window instead of showing previews.

title: Hide Gallery from File Explorer
detail: Removes the Gallery entry from Explorer's navigation pane.

title: Hide the Settings home page
detail: Settings opens without the promotional home page.

title: Disable synchronization of all Windows settings
detail: No settings of any kind roam to other devices with your account.

title: Disable design settings synchronization
detail: Themes and desktop design no longer roam between devices.

title: Disable browser settings synchronization
detail: Browser settings no longer roam between devices.

title: Disable credential synchronization
detail: Saved passwords and credentials no longer roam between devices.

title: Disable language settings synchronization
detail: Language preferences no longer roam between devices.

title: Disable "Other Windows settings" synchronization
detail: The remaining Windows settings no longer roam between devices.

title: Use Strict tracking prevention in Edge
detail: Edge blocks harmful trackers and the majority of trackers from all sites. Some parts of some sites might not work.

title: Stop Edge personalizing ads, search and news
detail: Microsoft no longer uses your browsing to personalize advertising and content in Edge.

title: Limit Edge diagnostic data to required only
detail: Edge sends only the diagnostic data Microsoft requires, not the optional extra.

title: Disable Edge feedback
detail: Removes the feedback button and prompts from Edge.

title: Stop sites checking for your saved payment methods
detail: Websites can no longer ask Edge whether you have a payment method saved.

title: Disable credit-card autofill in Edge
detail: Edge stops saving and filling payment card details.

title: Disable address suggestions in Edge forms
detail: Edge stops saving and suggesting postal addresses in forms.

title: Disable search and site suggestions in the Edge address bar
detail: What you type in the address bar is no longer sent to the search provider for suggestions.

title: Disable local suggestions in the Edge address bar
detail: The address bar stops suggesting from local providers such as history and favourites sources.

title: Disable the Bing provider in the Edge address bar
detail: Microsoft Search in Bing no longer contributes suggestions to the address bar.

title: Disable Edge's web service for navigation errors
detail: When a page cannot be reached, Edge no longer sends the address to a Microsoft service for suggestions.

title: Disable Edge page preloading
detail: Edge stops predicting which pages you will visit and loading them in advance.

title: Disable password saving in Edge
detail: Edge stops offering to save passwords and stops filling saved ones.

title: Disable the Edge shopping assistant
detail: Removes price comparisons, coupons and shopping pop-ups from Edge.

title: Disable the Edge sidebar
detail: Removes the sidebar and its apps from the edge of the browser window.

title: Disable content on the Edge new tab page
detail: The new tab page shows no news or promoted content.

title: Disable quick links on the Edge new tab page
detail: Removes the quick-links tiles from the new tab page.

title: Hide Bing Chat on the Edge new tab page
detail: Removes the Bing Chat entry point from the new tab page.

title: Disable Edge Spotlight experiences
detail: Stops the rotating promotional experiences and recommendations in Edge.

title: Skip Edge's first-run experience
detail: The welcome screens and splash shown the first time Edge runs are skipped.

title: Disable automatic sign-in to websites in Edge
detail: Edge no longer signs you in to Microsoft websites automatically.

title: Stop Edge asking to become the default browser
detail: Edge no longer checks or prompts about the default browser.

title: Disable Visual Search in Edge
detail: Removes image-based searching from Edge.

title: Disable Edge startup boost
detail: Edge no longer starts in the background to open faster; it starts when you open it.

title: Disable built-in AI APIs for websites in Edge
detail: Websites can no longer use the AI models built into Edge.

title: Disable AI-generated themes in Edge
detail: Removes the AI theme generator from Edge.

title: Hide the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon in Edge
detail: Removes the Copilot Chat icon from the Edge toolbar.

title: Disable Copilot in Edge
detail: Removes Copilot and its sidebar entry from Edge.

title: Disable inline Compose in Edge
detail: Removes the AI writing assistant that appears in text fields.

title: Stop Copilot reading page content in Edge
detail: For work and school profiles, Copilot can no longer read the page you are viewing. Set by Microsoft policy CopilotPageContext.

title: Disable AI history search in Edge
detail: Edge stops using AI to search your browsing history.

title: Disable text prediction in Edge
detail: Edge stops suggesting the next words while you type.

title: Disable Microsoft Editor spell checking in Edge
detail: What you type is no longer sent to Microsoft Editor for spell checking. The basic built-in checker is unaffected.

title: Hide Microsoft Rewards in Edge
detail: Removes the Rewards icon and prompts from Edge.

title: Hide the Adobe Acrobat button in Edge
detail: Removes the Acrobat subscription button from the PDF viewer.

title: Disable feature recommendations in Edge
detail: Stops Edge suggesting features and showing assistance notifications.

title: Turn on Game Mode
detail: When a game runs, Windows gives it first call on the processor and pauses updates and restarts. This is the switch in Settings › Gaming › Game Mode.

title: Turn off game recording and broadcasting
detail: Windows stops capturing and broadcasting gameplay in the background, which costs processor time while you play. Set by policy, the way Windows documents it.

title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
detail: The graphics card schedules its own work instead of the processor doing it, which can smooth games out. Needs a graphics card and driver that support it — on anything else Windows simply ignores the setting.

title: Turn off power throttling
detail: Windows stops slowing background work down to save power, so background programs run at full speed. On a laptop this uses noticeably more battery — it is the "Turn off Power Throttling" policy.

title: Stop Store apps running in the background
detail: Store apps no longer run when you are not using them, freeing memory and processor time. Fully applies after you sign out and back in.

title: Visual effects: best performance
detail: The same choice as "Adjust for best performance" in Performance Options: animations, shadows and fading are turned down so the desktop feels snappier, mostly on older PCs.

title: Menus open straight away
detail: Removes the 400-millisecond wait before submenus open as you hover. Honestly: this makes Windows feel faster rather than be faster.
